Glints is a talent recruitment and career development platform that connects job seekers and employers through technology and services. It has grown into one of Southeast Asia’s leading career development and recruitment platforms, serving millions of job seekers and tens of thousands of companies across multiple countries in the region. Today, Glints is widely recognized as a trusted recruitment ecosystem. Alibaba Cloud provides extensive data center coverage across Southeast Asia, backed by robust local capabilities that ensure high system reliability.

business_outcome: After consolidating and migrating its cloud infrastructure to Alibaba Cloud, Glints achieved over 100% improvement in per-capita service cost efficiency. By leveraging Alibaba Cloud’s infrastructure and native services, Glints replaced multiple high-cost third-party solutions, including chat systems, data analytics, data warehousing, and email delivery, resulting in substantial infrastructure cost reductions. Furthermore, API latency decreased by more than 50% , significantly improving user experience. Built as a foundation model for enterprise use, Qwen supports capabilities such as job content generation, document understanding, and multilingual language processing, helping Glints streamline recruiter-facing tasks while maintaining consistency and control across the platform.
